title: 第1170章 齐聚盘龙岛第1169章 血海冥河尸山
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
尸山是三大禁地里阴气数量最为浓厚的。
只见尸山内部诞生无数黑色的雾状阴气，这些阴气一到半空，便凝结成液态阴气，然后化作阴雨滴落到冥河当中。
冥河之水，全是这些阴雨而成。
因此，尸山上空一直在下雨。
赵寒微微眯眼，强撑着对那些尸体面孔的心里不适。
整个人顷刻间化作一团细小的阴气，然后迅速穿梭在阴雨当中，从一条缝隙进入了尸山内部。
刚一进入尸山内部，赵寒便感觉进入了水里的感觉一样。
再一看周围，全是血红的海水。
这特么不是血海，又能是哪里？
“尸山内部就是血海？”
赵寒一愣，有些不明所以。
不过，赵寒毕竟是蓝星的人，很快看懂了这一套流程。
不就是蒸发、降雨吗！
血海连接着尸山，血海的水被尸山所蒸发上升，然后降雨化作冥河，冥河流入血海，阴气从此源源不断。
这一套下来，能够供给给九幽用不完的阴气。
九幽的整体运行机制，大致就是如此。
赵寒呼出一口气，整个人以阴气形式，不断在血海底部游动。
游了一圈，干干净净，什么也没有发现。
最后，赵寒浮现于血海的上空，恢复本身，静静看着血海默默沉思。
之前的阴雾，哪里去了？

之前三大禁地内部能够吞噬一切的神秘存在，现在却消失了。
里面到底有什么？
赵寒想了半天，都没能想到个所以然。
最终还是将一切都推到地狱第一层的神秘存在身上。
当赵寒灵魂回到阳间后，便不再离开铁手禅院，而是静静等待选拔的结束。
选拔仅仅用了三天而已，便选出了所有前去论道的人员。
明珠这位神尼赫然在其中，反而是笑面佛等经常和明珠进行欢喜禅的佛陀，并未入选。
这可把笑面佛他们都给惊到了。
明明明珠这段时间并未进行欢喜禅，实力没有进境，为何选拔如此亮眼，竟然成功出线。
难道明珠还留有其他提升实力的手段吗？
八名罗汉，三位佛陀，一名神尼，总计十二位高僧入选。
另有一位，则是六道之首人道百面佛内定的，是八十一佛当中排名第三的无相佛。
传闻这无相佛，和百面佛长得九分像，乃是百面佛进入释门之前的儿子所生后代。
百面佛在很早之前选择成为僧人，进行断舍离后，抛妻弃子不问世事。
直到百面佛成为六道之首的人道，拥有了释门仅次于释尊最大的话语权后。
便离开西方佛国，进入十万大山东部，带回来一名孩童。
这名孩童就是后来的无相佛，也是八十一佛当中最年轻，也是修炼最迅速的。
年仅不到百岁而已便成就大帝，同样也被百面佛委以重任。
选择无相佛，其他五道毫无疑问。
因为无相佛看似年轻仅有百岁，似乎修炼尚浅，根基不稳。
content_en:
Corpse Mountain is the one with the strongest amount of Yin Qi among the three forbidden areas.
Countless black mist-like yin energy was seen inside the corpse mountain. Once the yin energy reached the air, it condensed into liquid yin energy, and then turned into raindrops and fell into the Styx River.
The water of the Styx is all made of these rains.
Therefore, it has been raining over the mountain of corpses.
Zhao Han squinted his eyes slightly, trying to hold back his discomfort at the faces of the corpses.
The whole person instantly turned into a small ball of yin energy, and then quickly shuttled through the rain, entering the interior of the corpse mountain through a gap.
As soon as he entered the corpse mountain, Zhao Han felt the same as entering the water.
Looking around again, it was all blood-red sea water.
If this isn't a sea of ​​blood, where could it be?
"Is there a sea of blood inside the mountain of corpses?"
Zhao Han was stunned for a moment, a little confused.
However, Zhao Han was from Blue Star after all and quickly understood this process.
Isn’t it just evaporation and rainfall?
The blood sea is connected to the corpse mountain. The water in the blood sea is evaporated and rises by the corpse mountain. Then the rain turns into the Styx. The Styx flows into the blood sea, and the yin energy flows continuously from then on.
This set can supply Jiuyou with inexhaustible Yin Qi.
The overall operating mechanism of Jiuyou is roughly like this.
Zhao Han exhaled, and his whole body continued to swim at the bottom of the blood sea in the form of Yin Qi.
I swam around and found nothing.
Finally, Zhao Han appeared above the sea of ​​blood, restored himself, and quietly looked at the sea of ​​blood and meditated silently.
Where has the previous mist gone?
The mysterious existence that could swallow everything inside the three forbidden areas has now disappeared.
What's inside?
Zhao Han thought for a long time, but couldn't think of a reason.
In the end, everything was pushed to the mysterious existence on the first level of hell.
When Zhao Han's soul returned to the earthly world, he no longer left the Iron Hand Temple, but quietly waited for the selection to end.
The selection only took three days to select all the people who came to discuss the Tao.
The deity Mingzhu was among them, but the Smiling Buddha and other Buddhas who often performed joyful meditation with Mingzhu were not selected.
This shocked Smiling Buddha and the others.
Mingming Mingzhu did not perform a happy meditation during this period, and her strength has not improved. Why was she so brilliant in the selection and successfully qualified?
Does Mingzhu still have other means to improve her strength?
Eight Arhats, three Buddhas, and one nun, a total of twelve eminent monks were selected.
There is another one, the leader of the Six Paths, the Human Realm Hundred-Faced Buddha, who is the third-ranked Formless Buddha among the eighty-one Buddhas.
It is said that this formless Buddha, who looks nine-quarters like the Hundred-Faced Buddha, is the descendant of the son of the Hundred-Faced Buddha before he entered Buddhism.
The Hundred-Faced Buddha chose to become a monk a long time ago. After renunciation, he abandoned his wife and children and became independent of worldly affairs.
Until the Hundred-Faced Buddha became the leader of the Six Paths of Humanity and had the greatest say in Buddhism after the Buddha.
Then he left the Buddhist kingdom in the west and entered the eastern part of Shiwanda Mountain, bringing back a child.
This child was the later Formless Buddha, the youngest among the eighty-one Buddhas, and the fastest in cultivation.
He became a great emperor when he was less than a hundred years old, and was also entrusted with important responsibilities by the Hundred-Faced Buddha.
If you choose the Formless Buddha, there will be no doubt about the other five paths.
Because the Formless Buddha appears to be only a hundred years old, his cultivation seems to be shallow and his foundation is unstable.
